name: Hydro / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A deep collapsing water pocket, a forceful dense splash and a rolling hollow liquid gurgle, followed by turbulent water draining and scattered heavy droplets. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
